messages:
Alex M: Kicking the initial go/no-go for nova1 GPU cluster. Need fast confirmations on networking, GPU health, schedulability, and a quick cost sanity. I'll drop a tiny checklist — @Priya R @Dan K @Sasha L, can you run the items and paste outputs?

Priya R: pulling node state now. running `kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=pool=gold` — will paste shortly.

Dan K: I'll run the t2-llm-smoke workload (100 reqs) against the canary endpoint and report latencies + errors.

infra-bot: AUTO: cluster nova1 created (region:nova) — GPUs=128, node_pools=gold(4x8GPU), provision_time=2025-11-01T10:12:23Z

Sasha L: quick network check: `curl -sS http://10.2.3.4:8080/health` -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK, payload: `{\"status\":\"ok\"}` :white_check_mark:

Priya R: nodes show 4 Ready nodes. paste of `kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=pool=gold`:
```
ip-10-2-3-101 Ready 8/8 gpu  kubernetes-node   10.2.3.101  nova
ip-10-2-3-102 Ready 8/8 gpu  kubernetes-node   10.2.3.102  nova
ip-10-2-3-103 Ready 8/8 gpu  kubernetes-node   10.2.3.103  nova
ip-10-2-3-104 Ready 8/8 gpu  kubernetes-node   10.2.3.104  nova
```
All nodes report GPU resource allocatable and `nvidia` drivers present. Ran `kubectl describe node ip-10-2-3-101 | grep -A2 "Allocatable"` -> GPUs: 8

Dan K: smoke run finished: 100 requests to /v1/generate-canary -> p50=78ms, p95=142ms, errors=0, OOMs=0. Worker logs show no CUDA errors. sample log line: `INFO model_inference: request_id=... latency_ms=142`

Alex M: Quick SLO checks against our gates: p95 < 150ms (pass), error rate < 0.5% (pass), node readiness 100% (pass). GPU util target 60-85% -> observed avg 72% over 5m (good).

Sasha L: disk & kubelet: ephemeral usage <15% on all nodes, kubelet eviction pressure none. ip-10-2-3-103 briefly reported driver mismatch during init, I rolled that node (systemctl restart nvidia-driver && kubectl cordon && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets && kubectl uncordon) — it came back Ready.

Priya R: KV/cache check: redis cluster handshake succeeded, prefix cache warm, `redis-cli -c -h redis-main PING` -> PONG. Also verified prefix K/V hit-rate after warmup ~82% on canary traces.

Dan K: One small flake: our CI image had an old CUDA toolkit tag on one pod which caused a fallback path for ~0.2% of requests. Fixed with `image: redwood/llm-runtime:cuda12.1-20251101` and redeployed. No user impact.

Alex M: Cost sanity: ballpark estimate with current instance types ~ $3.9/hour for the pool (on-demand). Recommend reserving if sustained. Also flagging quota: account GPU quota remaining = 320, ok for now.

Sasha L: Will open the handoff ticket and run the short ops playbook. I can own the oncall handoff.

Dan K: Test ticket created: INF-4321 — description: nova1 initial canary + go/no-go, includes perf snippets + node fix note. Assigning to Platform SRE. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321

Alex M: Good. Action items: 1) Sasha to do handoff + add checklist to runbook, 2) Priya to paste final `kubectl top nodes` and GPU allocations into ticket, 3) Dan to monitor p95 for next 30m and escalate on spikes >170ms. Once those are done we flip canary traffic from 0% -> 5%.

Priya R: `kubectl top nodes --selector=pool=gold` -> gpu utilization: 68%, 71%, 75%, 73%. Pushing outputs to INF-4321.

Dan K: Monitoring in progress, will post updates in the ticket thread.

Alex M: OK — marking this thread as the authoritative go/no-go record for nova1 initial bring online. Proceeding to allow canary rollout to 5% after Sasha confirms handoff ticket and Priya's final metrics. :thumbsup:
